referenceList.doiPolicy: Include DOIs if available, written in full with either a 'doi:' or an 'https://doi.org/' prefix

provenance.claim: mode: author-year — 'References should be cited in text by the last name of the author(s) and the date of publication', with first initials per current style
authorYear: initials included, '&' joins two authors, 'et al.' from 3 authors, no comma before the date
authorTruncation: articles with more than five authors list the first three followed by 'et al.'
journalAbbreviation: ADS bibliographic codes 'except in rare instances (e.g., Icarus)'
doiPolicy: DOIs written in full with either a 'doi:' or an 'https://doi.org/' prefix
collapseRanges: false — no collating rules are stated; numeric ranges are not applicable to author-year citations
minFontPt: 6 — 'A minimum of 6 pt. font size is acceptable' at final size
lineWeightPt.min: 0.5 — 'Lines in figures should be at minimum 0.5 points'
formats.minDpi: 300, with at least 1000 px of horizontal resolution for raster figures
colorAsSoleDelimiter: forbidden — 'the use of color as the only distinguishing delimiter in a figure should be generally avoided'
widthPresetsMm: all null — column widths in mm are not stated on the official Graphics Guide
panelLabel: all null — only placement (letter inside the box) is stated; case/weight/punctuation are not

wordLimit.scope: main text, not including acknowledgments, appendices or other supplementary material

provenance.claim: abstractWordLimit: 'not more than 250 words' for main AAS journals; 150 for RNAAS
runningHeadLimitChars: 44 — short title 'not more than 44 characters'
apj-letter wordLimit: 3500 words soft — limits 'are no longer intended to be compulsory'
rnaas wordLimit: hard 1500-word total including references and captions
submissionFormat.lineNumbers: true — required for submission and revision (RNAAS excepted)

notes: ApJL word/display-item limits are 'no longer intended to be compulsory' — exceeding manuscripts considered at Scientific Editor discretion; each ApJL figure is limited to 9 panels.
RNAAS: a single figure OR table (not both); do not use line numbers. All other AAS journals REQUIRE line numbers at submission/revision (AASTeX 'linenumbers' option or lineno.sty).

Reference list ordering: same author(s) chronological; same authors + same year get lowercase suffixes (2025a, 2025b); 'et al.' entries grouped together and last, as if the fourth author started with 'z'.
Preprints are citable only for manuscripts not yet published; all sources cited in text and tables (including online-only tables) must appear in the reference list.
In-text: natbib \citep/\citet with the latest aasjournal.bst required; three or more authors cite as first author et al.; no comma before the date.

Color must not be the sole distinguishing delimiter: colored lines also need distinct line styles, colored symbols distinct shapes, colored histograms distinct hatching or weights (Color Oracle recommended for checking).
Panel letters in multipart figures go inside the box around the figure, not outside; case/weight/punctuation convention is not stated (AAS template practice is lowercase (a), (b)).
Raster figures need at least 1000 px horizontal resolution at 300 DPI on the final PDF page (~single-column at final size); interactive-figure viewport is 650 px wide.
Images must not be used for tables or equations.
A dedicated Data Availability section is not stated as required; data/software citation rules live on the References and Data Guide pages.
Word template: Courier New 10 pt at 1.5 line spacing (Times New Roman 12 pt or Calibri 12 pt also allowed); AASTeX 'manuscript' style option produces 12 pt double-spaced single-column output.
Journal abbreviations follow ADS bibliographic codes 'except in rare instances (e.g., Icarus)'.

Section order: title page, abstract, text with integrated figures/tables, acknowledgments (with author contributions, facilities, software) before the bibliography, appendices, references; each author needs an \email command.
